implementation_scope: Explicit local RCVEC001 source-cache import bound to authorized event refs, exact UTF-8 source ranges, text hashes, model, dimensions and cache identity.
Atomically committed private index with streamed contiguous pack, per-record binary hashes, bounded IO, no resident corpus cache.
Optional local-only query-vector import and overlay; unavailable query vector yields visible lexical fallback.
Direct and managed stdio MCP integration with original authorization, revocation, source revalidation and bounded graph context.
Existing equal-weight RRF ranking preserved; storage changes do not establish retrieval quality.
public_test_data: Independent artificial conversations and normalized 3-D vectors only; no real conversations, queries, cache material or personal experiment outputs.

tested_boundaries: Nonlexical hit deep inside a long message retains exact winning chunk range and follows verified source edges.
Role, scope and suppression filters are applied before loading candidate vector payloads.
Managed connection revocation blocks event-vector retrieval.
Wrong model, source hash, UTF-8 range, vector header or norm rejects import without a partial index or temporary pack.
Corrupt pack payload, invalid offset, size or hash fails closed.
Legacy cache and packed storage produce identical toy rankings, source ranges, context windows and cursors.
Existing index changes invalidate reads; source-cache symlinks are rejected.
Query import binds exact UTF-8 query bytes and does not overwrite files.
Uncached query fallback remains visible with no results and 512-byte result budget.
No encoder, provider API, Python worker or credential loading is introduced.
limitations: Exact bounded local scan, not ANN or arbitrary-corpus latency guarantee.
Only preexisting or explicitly imported query vectors support semantic event ranking.
Equal-weight RRF can elevate weak lexical agreement above a stronger semantic-only result; full production retrieval must be evaluated separately.
Known fixture regressions are not blind evaluation; no public model-quality claim is made here.
Byte budgets measure result JSON UTF-8 bytes, not downstream model tokens or whole MCP framing.
Desktop/native IPC setup does not configure this offline event index.
